title: CRAFTY+ USB-C Vaporizer Complete Set (taxes extra)
description:
THE CRAFTY+ USB-C VERSION

ALL STORZ VAPORIZERS ARE REGULAR STOCK

The new adventure begins now. The battery-powered CRAFTY+ is the perfect companion for all your pursuits. Handy and compact, the CRAFTY+ provides you with outstanding vapor quality, flavor and air flow for elevated everyday experiences. Don’t sacrifice performance for portability – get both with the CRAFTY+

The CRAFTY+ uses a combination of convection and conduction heating – a technology proven to excel in heating up herb evenly and efficiently. In addition, the powerful heating system allows for exceptional air flow and allows you to breathe in effortlessly.

Features USB-C version:
USB-C charging socket
25 minutes faster charging
One-button control
3 pre-set temperatures
Personalized settings through app
1,4 cm³ sized ceramic coated filliing chamber
Exceptional air flow
Pure taste
App control

BONUS ITEMS: Storz Grinder, 2 Grime Sticks, 2 Cleaning Sticks, 1 Cleaning Brush

Package includes:
1 pc. CRAFTY+
1 pc. USB-C Cable
3 pcs. Base Seal Ring, small
3 pcs. Normal Screen, small
3 pcs. Coarse Screen, small
1 pc. Dosing Capsule
1 pc. Cleaning Brush
1 pc. Instruction for Use (concise)
1 pc. Safety Instructions

Warranty Information
